text:
rachael: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few specific timeline questions about the Console rollout, Optimize recommendations, and API batching knobs. Can someone on product/eng clarify?

sam: +1. Folks asked for concrete dates for the console feature flags and the canary window for the new instrumentation dashboard.

maria: From product side: Console GA target is 'late May' but we promised a canary next week. Canary will be internal + 3 partner accounts for two weeks.

kevin: Technical note: the canary only includes routes for generation + embeddings. Routing fallback & dedicated capacity support land in the follow-up canary (week after).

rachael: Thanks — are there SLO/metrics we should surface to partners during canary? latency P50/P95, error rates, and token cost impact?

maria: Yes, canonical list: p50 latency, p95 latency, 5xx rate, average tokens/req, and an early quality regression metric from the eval harness. We'll add a concise dashboard tile.

olivia: On Optimize — when do the model/quantization recommendation suggestions hit the Console UI? Customers want the suggestion panel in the UI not just the CLI.

kevin: Optimize UI panels are on the roadmap for v1.0 of Console GA, but we can ship a limited "Quick Suggestions" modal during the canary (read-only) by adding an API endpoint that surfaces recommendations. ETA: canary week + 7 days.

rachael: Can we confirm the gating criteria to move from canary -> GA for Console? Anything blockers we can remove now?

maria: Gating: 1) no P95 regressions > 20% vs baseline, 2) <0.2% 5xx, 3) partner sign-off on UX, 4) Optimize suggestions validated on at least 2 internal workloads.

sam: Ops question: will canary traffic be routed to Dedicated by default or to Hosted? We need to know to pre-warm capacity.

kevin: Partner canary traffic goes to Hosted in the canary phase. Dedicated routing test happens in the follow-up canary. We'll need to pre-warm two GPU pools for the follow-up.

rachael: OK — who's owning the communication to partners about the canary acceptance criteria and the exact window?

maria: I'll own partner comms. Sam/Eng: can you provide the short runbook and the sample dashboard by EOD Friday?

sam: Yup — runbook + dashboard link by Friday. I'll ping eng-ops-bot when it's published.

eng-ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-dashboard:v1 -> staging at 2024-05-02T18:00Z (auto-notify partners).

olivia: Small ask from sales: can we include a short blurb about the Optimize modal capabilities for partner outreach? One-liner + expected GA month is enough.

maria: I'll draft the blurb and share in #marketing tomorrow. Target GA month in messaging: June.

rachael: Great, that helps. Last ask — any risk that Optimize suggestions will be behind feature flags requiring DB migrations that could delay GA?

kevin: There's one lightweight migration for recommendation history; it's backward compatible. No blocking DB changes. Feature flag gating exists so we can rollback quickly.

rachael: Perfect. Thanks everyone — please add any outstanding follow-ups in this thread and mark owners. :party_parrot:
